native.subject: UniProtKB:P04951
native.description: Current database convention; primary studies instead identify beta-pyranose Kdo as the accepted KdsB substrate. This edge does not establish experimental alpha catalysis. The gene-product role does not assert isolated monomer sufficiency.

evidence.source_assertion: KdsB is assigned current RHEA:23448 by HAMAP MF_00057 (ECO:0000255). The alpha-Kdo substrate is a database convention, not direct experimental alpha catalysis.
The MG1655 native polypeptide unifies P04951 and cites the preference for beta-pyranose Kdo. The frame name does not establish active monomer sufficiency.

The E. coli LPS-specific KdsB structures contain dimers with an opposite-subunit CTP interaction; its kinetic discussion identifies beta-pyranose Kdo as accepted substrate. Expression in BL21 does not establish donor-strain identity.
